title: Cracking the Coding Interview
description: An original practice track covering the coding questions of Cracking the Coding Interview, 6th edition, with Python and Java references and hidden edge-case tests. Questions that match a LeetCode problem link to it; the rest are written for this site. This is a private study aid, not a reproduction of the book.

title: Beyond Cracking the Coding Interview
description: Original practice for 232 of the 234 Beyond Cracking the Coding Interview problems, covering chapters 25 to 43 and all 37 problems from the five online chapters: Set & Map Implementations, Monotonic Stacks & Queues, Union-Find, Boundary Thinking, and Booster Problems. Includes Python and Java references and hidden tests. Two book problems requiring additional harness support remain unavailable.

title: SQL 50
description: LeetCode's SQL 50 study plan in SQLite: selection, joins, aggregation, grouping, subqueries and string functions. Statements and tests are written for this site.

title: Concurrency
description: LeetCode's multithreading problems, judged on real threads in Java, C++ and Go. Each test repeats with random start delays to surface races, and deadlocks are reported instead of hanging.

title: Object-Oriented Design
description: Executable low-level design: classes with state and invariants, judged by sequences of method calls. Pair them with the Low-Level Design Practice guide for the modeling discussion.

title: ML Coding
description: Original problems for machine learning coding rounds: implement softmax, attention, k-means, logistic regression, retrieval and evaluation metrics from scratch with only the standard library.

title: Blind 75
description: The classic 75 problems that cover every core interview pattern.

title: Grind 75
description: A modernized, ordered take on Blind 75.

title: NeetCode 150
description: Blind 75 plus more practice per pattern, grouped by topic.

title: Grind 169
description: The full Grind list for a longer study plan.
